name: CAQH ProView
description: CAQH ProView is the industry-standard universal provider data repository that allows healthcare providers to maintain their professional, practice, and credentialing information in a single, secure location. Used by over 1.4 million healthcare providers, it streamlines the credentialing process by enabling providers to self-report data once and share it with multiple health plans and healthcare organizations.
short_description: Free, industry-standard credentialing repository used by 1.4M+ providers to share verified data with health plans.
one_liner: Universal provider credentialing data repository - free for providers

pricing.free_tier_details: Free for all healthcare providers - costs covered by participating health plans
pricing.notes: CAQH ProView is free for healthcare providers. Health plans and healthcare organizations pay subscription fees to access provider data. There is no cost for providers to create, maintain, or attest to their CAQH profile.

company.legal_name: Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare, Inc.
company.description: CAQH is a non-profit alliance of health plans and trade associations that creates shared initiatives to streamline healthcare administration. ProView is their flagship provider credentialing solution.

compliance.notes: CAQH maintains rigorous data security standards and is widely recognized as the industry standard for provider credentialing data

integrations.name: Health Plan Systems
integrations.description: Direct integration with major health plan credentialing systems

integrations.name: Credentialing Software
integrations.description: API access for credentialing vendors and health systems

best_for: Any healthcare provider requiring credentialing with insurance payers
Providers who want to maintain credentials in one central location
Providers working with multiple health plans
not_ideal_for: Cash-only practices not working with insurance
Organizations seeking full credentialing automation (ProView is data repository, not workflow)
